## Problem 1 

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
library(ggplot2)

penguin_plot = ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = flipper_length_mm,
    color = species
  )
) +
  geom_point()

penguin_plot

```
